notes: No cheats yet: find them with the Scanner while you play. Money is the easy one: pause, note it, unpause until it changes, scan again. If i32 finds nothing, try i64, then f32. This is a Unity game, so pointer paths go through UnityPlayer.dll or mono-2.0-bdwgc.dll and are long; Pointers searches deeper automatically when short paths fail. Re-check them after a restart before trusting them.
